presentation: A 70-year-old woman with hypertension, diabetes, left ventricular dysfunction with LBBB, prior left colectomy for diverticulitis, GERD, PUD, and a history of GI bleeding presents after a recent admission to an outside hospital for recurrent hematochezia and change in stool caliber. CT angiography was normal, her vital signs and hemoglobin remained stable, so she was discharged home without further work-up. What further follow-up, if any, is recommended?
